SEO.Title: Felix Leupold · Senior Full-Stack Engineer · XIEL
SEO.Description: Freelance senior full-stack engineer in Berlin. I build web products and AI systems with React, Next.js, Node.js and TypeScript.

Intro.Title: I'm a freelance full-stack engineer from Berlin. I build fast, accessible products, from the first idea to release.
Intro.Text: For more than 15 years, I have built web products for German and international companies. Most recently, I built AI systems that thousands of people use every day. I work end to end, from architecture and backend to the last detail of the interface. I care about user experience, accessibility and clean code. And the universe. And everything in between.

Technologies.Title: Technologies
Technologies.Text: From data-heavy dashboards and identity platforms to AI assistants used by thousands of colleagues: I combine proven open-source tools with modern cloud and AI technologies to build fast, accessible products end to end.
